title: Rich Chocolate Pots de Crème with Chocolate Shavings
summary: Deep, dense chocolate pots de crème made from a stirred custard poured over dark chocolate, finished with chocolate shavings.

ingredients.item: dark chocolate (60-70% cocoa solids), finely chopped
ingredients.note: check the label for soya and milk

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Set up
steps.text: put the chopped chocolate in the heatproof bowl and rest the sieve over it.

steps.title: Custard
steps.text: whisk the yolks, sugar and salt, then whisk in the cream and milk. Cook in the pan over medium-low heat, stirring and scraping the base constantly, 8-12 min, until it thickens to a silky coat on the spoon and reads 80-82 °C. Never let it simmer. At 80-82 °C the yolks thicken the custard and are safely cooked.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: pour it at once through the sieve onto the chocolate, leave 5 min, then whisk gently until smooth with the vanilla and espresso. Resting first lets the chocolate melt without overmixing.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: divide between the ramekins, tap to level, cool 15 min, then cover and chill at least 4 h.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: rest at room temperature 20 min, then shave the extra chocolate over the tops with the peeler. A short rest at room temperature softens the texture and lifts the flavour.

tips: A common mistake is letting the custard simmer, which scrambles the yolks; keep the heat low and stir all the time.
Use a thermometer; the custard thickens only slightly.
Shave chocolate from a block at room temperature for curls.
storage: Cover and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days. Add the shavings just before serving.
